sn14.2:1.2: The use of the word _paṭicca_ here connects back to dependent origination. Narrowing in on the particulars of sense experience, the text shows that particular factors give rise to other correlated factors, i.e. “this gives rise to this” ([sn12.37:2.2]()).
sn14.2:1.4: Discourses 2–5 treat the internal sense fields, while 6–10 treat the external sense fields.
